proposedGoal.title: Nichtnegative Dezimalzahlen auf eine vorgegebene Stelle runden
proposedGoal.titleEn: Round nonnegative decimals to a specified place
proposedGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann nichtnegative endliche Dezimalzahlen auf eine vorgegebene Stelle zum nächstgelegenen Nachbarwert auf dieser Stelle runden, bei genau halbem Abstand nach der angegebenen Schulregel den größeren Wert wählen, die Entscheidung mit der Bedeutung der Dezimalstellen einschließlich Nullen und Überträgen begründen und Runden vom Abschneiden unterscheiden.
proposedGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can round nonnegative terminating decimals to the nearest value at a specified place, choose the larger value at an exact halfway point under the stated school rule, justify the choice using decimal place-value meaning including zeros and carrying, and distinguish rounding from truncation.

sourceApplicabilityClaim: Author-proposed common nonnegative terminating-decimal core with partial16-source support. Exact source/grade/stage/placement and universality remain independently pending. phaseJ6 is compatibility grouping only.

intrinsicPreparation.neededUnderstandingDe: Stellen rechts vom Komma teilen die links benachbarte Einheit jeweils in zehn gleiche Teile. Eine Null hält ihre Stelle frei; zehn kleinere Einheiten werden zu einer Einheit links gebündelt. Die Zielstelle legt den Abstand zwischen zwei benachbarten möglichen Rundungswerten fest.
intrinsicPreparation.neededUnderstandingEn: Each place to the right of the decimal point divides the adjacent unit on its left into ten equal parts. A zero preserves its place; ten smaller units regroup as one unit to the left. The target place sets the step between neighboring possible rounded values.
intrinsicPreparation.assistance: Optional blank labelled digit-place table; labels may remain but learner fills digits and independently decides. No highlighted decisive digit, completed table, selected neighbor or supplied rounded answer in fresh probes.
intrinsicPreparation.granularityDecision: Needed narrow place-value/regrouping meaning is taught and assessed inside this single rounding operation. No nonexistent narrower approved prerequisite ID is invented. Independent atomicity/granularity review remains pending.

alignmentRule: Given target place; nearest conventional school rounding; exact positive tie chooses the larger value. This specifies the school operation, not an arbitrary target-answer rule or a general alternative-rule curriculum.

domainBoundaries.required: Nonnegative terminating decimals, including a positive input whose rounded output is zero.
domainBoundaries.signedTransfer: Optional separate future source/method/placement review; no signed-rounding mastery or universal Physics applicability claimed.
excluded: selecting a place from measurement uncertainty or context
constructing a separately scaled number line
